verses.original: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא רָעָ֑ה וְאַל־ בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י תִּתְאָו לִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·qan·nê rā·‘āh wə·’al- bə·’an·šê tiṯ·ʾå̄w lih·yō·wṯ ’it·tām
verses.literal: Do not envy wicked . . . men or desire their company . . .

verses.original: כִּי־ לִבָּ֑ם יֶהְגֶּ֣ה שֹׁ֭ד שִׂפְתֵיהֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃ וְ֝עָמָ֗ל
verses.transliteration: kî- lib·bām yeh·geh šōḏ śip̄·ṯê·hem tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh wə·‘ā·māl
verses.literal: for their hearts devise violence and their lips declare trouble

verses.original: בְּ֭חָכְמָה בָּ֑יִת יִבָּ֣נֶה וּ֝בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh bā·yiṯ yib·bā·neh ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nāh yiṯ·kō·w·nān
verses.literal: By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established

verses.original: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל־ יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃ ה֖וֹן
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ḥă·ḏā·rîm yim·mā·lə·’ū kāl- yā·qār wə·nā·‘îm hō·wn
verses.literal: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure

verses.original: חָכָ֥ם גֶּֽבֶר־ בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ־ דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ־ כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām ge·ḇer- ba·‘ō·wz wə·’îš- da·‘aṯ mə·’am·meṣ- kō·aḥ
verses.literal: A wise man [is] strong and a man of knowledge enhances his strength

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·ṯaḥ·bu·lō·wṯ ta·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā mil·ḥā·māh ū·ṯə·šū·‘āh bə·rōḇ yō·w·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Only with sound guidance should you wage war and victory lies in a multitude of counselors

verses.original: חָכְמ֑וֹת רָאמ֣וֹת לֶֽאֱוִ֣יל לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּֽיהוּ׃ בַּ֝שַּׁ֗עַר
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵə·mō·wṯ rā·mō·wṯ le·’ĕ·wîl lō yip̄·taḥ- pî·hū baš·ša·‘ar
verses.literal: Wisdom [is] too high for a fool he does not open his mouth in the meeting place

verses.original: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְהָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗וֹ יִקְרָֽאוּ׃ בַּֽעַל־ מְזִמּ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: mə·ḥaš·šêḇ lə·hā·rê·a‘ lōw yiq·rā·’ū ba·‘al- mə·zim·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: He who plots evil will be called a schemer . . .

verses.original: אִוֶּ֣לֶת זִמַּ֣ת חַטָּ֑את לֵֽץ׃ וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ zim·maṯ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lêṣ wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ lə·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: A foolish scheme is sin and a mocker is detestable to men

verses.original: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·rap·pî·ṯā bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh ṣar kō·ḥe·ḵāh
verses.literal: If you faint in the day of distress how small [is] your strength

verses.original: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃ וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣêl lə·qu·ḥîm lam·mā·weṯ taḥ·śō·wḵ ū·mā·ṭîm la·he·reḡ ’im-
verses.literal: Rescue those being led away to death and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא־ יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲ‍ֽלֹא־ הֽוּא־ תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת׀ יָבִ֗ין ה֣וּא וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯō·mar hên lō- yā·ḏa‘·nū zeh hălō- hū- ṯō·ḵên lib·bō·wṯ yā·ḇîn hū wə·nō·ṣêr nap̄·šə·ḵā yê·ḏā‘ wə·hê·šîḇ lə·’ā·ḏām kə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: If you say Behold we did not know about this does not He who weighs hearts consider it Does not the One who guards your life know Will He not repay a man according to his deeds

verses.original: אֱכָל־ דְבַ֣שׁ בְּנִ֣י כִּי־ ט֑וֹב וְנֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל־ חִכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḵāl- ḏə·ḇaš bə·nî kî- ṭō·wḇ wə·nō·p̄eṯ mā·ṯō·wq ‘al- ḥik·ke·ḵā
verses.literal: Eat honey my son for it is good and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste

verses.original: דְּעֶ֥ה כֵּ֤ן׀ חָכְמָ֗ה לְנַ֫פְשֶׁ֥ךָ אִם־ מָ֭צָאתָ וְיֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: də·‘eh kên ḥāḵ·māh lə·nap̄·še·ḵā ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯā wə·yêš ’a·ḥă·rîṯ wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: Know therefore that wisdom [is sweet] to your soul If you find it there is a future [for you] and your hope will never be cut off

verses.original: אַל־ תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל־ תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- te·’ĕ·rōḇ rā·šā‘ lin·wêh ṣad·dîq ’al- tə·šad·dêḏ riḇ·ṣō
verses.literal: Do not lie in wait O wicked [man] near the dwelling of the righteous do not destroy his resting place

verses.original: כִּ֤י צַדִּ֣יק יִפּ֣וֹל שֶׁ֨בַע׀ וָקָ֑ם וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṣad·dîq yip·pō·wl še·ḇa‘ wā·qām ū·rə·šā·‘îm yik·kā·šə·lū ḇə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: For though a righteous [man] may fall seven times he still gets up but the wicked stumble in bad [times]

verses.original: אַל־ תִּשְׂמָ֑ח אוֹיְבֶיךָ בִּנְפֹ֣ל אַל־ לִבֶּֽךָ׃ יָגֵ֥ל וּ֝בִכָּשְׁל֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·māḥ ʾō·yə·ḇɛ·ḵå̄ bin·p̄ōl ’al- lib·be·ḵā yā·ḡêl ū·ḇik·kā·šə·lōw
verses.literal: Do not gloat when your enemy falls and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles

verses.original: פֶּן־ יְ֭הוָה יִרְאֶ֣ה וְרַ֣ע בְּעֵינָ֑יו אַפּֽוֹ׃ וְהֵשִׁ֖יב מֵעָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: pen- Yah·weh yir·’eh wə·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nāw ’ap·pōw wə·hê·šîḇ mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: or the LORD will see and disapprove . . . and turn His wrath away from him

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־ תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּרְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ḥar bam·mə·rê·‘îm ’al- tə·qan·nê bā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: Do not fret over evildoers and do not be envious of the wicked

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לָרָ֑ע תִהְיֶ֣ה לֹֽא־ אַחֲרִ֣ית נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lā·rā‘ ṯih·yeh lō- ’a·ḥă·rîṯ nêr rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·‘āḵ
verses.literal: For the evil [man] has no future the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished

verses.original: בְּנִ֣י יְרָֽא־ יְהוָ֣ה וָמֶ֑לֶךְ אַל־ תִּתְעָרָֽב׃ עִם־ שׁוֹנִ֑ים אֶת־
verses.transliteration: bə·nî yə·rā- Yah·weh wā·me·leḵ ’al- tiṯ·‘ā·rāḇ ‘i·mō·šō- šō·w·nîm ’eṯ-
verses.literal: My son fear the LORD and the king and do not associate with the rebellious -

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָק֣וּם פִ֭תְאֹם אֵידָ֑ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ׃ס וּפִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·qūm p̄iṯ·’ōm ’ê·ḏām mî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ ū·p̄îḏ šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: For they will bring sudden destruction Who knows what ruin [they] can bring

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה גַּם־ לַֽחֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר־ פָּנִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh gam- la·ḥă·ḵā·mîm hak·kêr- pā·nîm bə·miš·pāṭ bal- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: These also are sayings of the wise To show partiality . . . in judgment is not good

verses.original: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר׀ לְרָשָׁע֮ אָ֥תָּה צַדִּ֪יק עַמִּ֑ים יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃ יִזְעָמ֥וּהוּ
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mêr lə·rā·šā‘ ’āt·tāh ṣad·dîq ‘am·mîm yiq·qə·ḇu·hū lə·’um·mîm yiz·‘ā·mū·hū
verses.literal: Whoever tells the guilty You are innocent peoples will curse him and nations will denounce him

verses.original: יִנְעָ֑ם וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים טֽוֹב׃ בִרְכַּת־ תָּב֥וֹא וַֽ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: yin·‘ām wə·lam·mō·w·ḵî·ḥîm ṭō·wḇ ḇir·kaṯ- tā·ḇō·w wa·‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty and rich blessing will come upon them

verses.original: נְכֹחִֽים׃ דְּבָרִ֥ים מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב יִשָּׁ֑ק שְׂפָתַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: nə·ḵō·ḥîm də·ḇā·rîm mê·šîḇ yiš·šāq śə·p̄ā·ṯa·yim
verses.literal: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips

verses.original: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּח֨וּץ׀ מְלַאכְתֶּ֗ךָ וְעַתְּדָ֣הּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּבָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·ḵên ba·ḥūṣ mə·laḵ·te·ḵā wə·‘at·tə·ḏāh baś·śā·ḏeh lāḵ ’a·ḥar ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field after that you may build your house

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֣י עֵד־ בְּרֵעֶ֑ךָ חִנָּ֣ם וַ֝הֲפִתִּ֗יתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ‘êḏ- bə·rê·‘e·ḵā ḥin·nām wa·hă·p̄it·tî·ṯā biś·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not testify . . . against your neighbor without cause and do not deceive with your lips

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַ֗ר עָֽשָׂה־ לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar ‘ā·śāh- lî kên ka·’ă·šer ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lōw ’ā·šîḇ lā·’îš kə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw
verses.literal: Do not say I will do to him . . . as he has done to me I will repay the man according to his work

verses.original: עָבַ֑רְתִּי עַל־ שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ־ עָצֵ֣ל וְעַל־ כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇar·tî ‘al- śə·ḏêh ’îš- ‘ā·ṣêl wə·‘al- ke·rem ’ā·ḏām ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: I went past the field of a slacker . . . and by the vineyard of a man lacking judgment

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨וֹ׀ חֲרֻלִּ֑ים כָּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣יו אֲבָנָ֣יו וְגֶ֖דֶר נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh qim·mə·śō·nîm ‘ā·lāh ḵul·lōw ḥă·rul·lîm kās·sū p̄ā·nāw ’ă·ḇā·nāw wə·ḡe·ḏer ne·hĕ·rā·sāh
verses.literal: - Thorns had grown up everywhere thistles had covered the ground and the stone wall was broken down

verses.original: אָ֭נֹכִֽי וָֽאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî wā·’e·ḥĕ·zeh ’ā·šîṯ lib·bî rā·’î·ṯî lā·qaḥ·tî mū·sār
verses.literal: I observed and took [it] to heart I looked and received instruction

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ šē·nôt̲ mə·‘aṭ tə·nū·mō·wṯ mə·‘aṭ ḥib·buq yā·ḏa·yim liš·kāḇ
verses.literal: A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to rest

verses.original: רֵישֶׁ֑ךָ וּבָֽא־ מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ וּ֝מַחְסֹרֶ֗יךָ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: rê·še·ḵā ū·ḇā- miṯ·hal·lêḵ ū·maḥ·sō·re·ḵā kə·’îš mā·ḡên
verses.literal: and poverty will come [upon you] like a robber and need like a bandit . . .
